_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "l1" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tr', "ui_locale" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tr', "time_budget_min" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, "weekly_days_goal" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 5, "anchors" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "quiet_hours" TEXT NULL, "goal_text" TEXT NULL, "interests" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "scaffold_overrides" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "settings" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "courses" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "l2" TEXT NOT NULL, "pair_pack" TEXT NOT NULL, "level_estimates" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "vocab_estimate" INTEGER NULL, "fsrs_params" TEXT NULL, "desired_retention" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.9, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "l2"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_items" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_l2" TEXT NOT NULL, "lemmas" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "cefr" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "gloss_l1" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "variants" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "deprecated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deprecated" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cards" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "fsrs_card_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" INTEGER NOT NULL, "step" INTEGER NULL, "stability" REAL NULL, "difficulty" REAL NULL, "due" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_review" TEXT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "lapses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "suspended" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("suspended" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("profile_id", "item_ref", "mode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempts" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_ref" TEXT NULL, "card_id" TEXT NULL, "task_ref" TEXT NULL, "text_ref" TEXT NULL, "parent_attempt_id" TEXT NULL, "prompt" TEXT NOT NULL, "response" TEXT NOT NULL, "verdict" TEXT NULL, "target_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("target_ok" IN (0, 1)), "error_tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "hints_used" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "hint_max_level" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "latency_ms" INTEGER NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "card_state_after" TEXT NULL, "llm" TEXT NULL, "experiment" TEXT NULL, "created_at_client" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attempt_amendments" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "gap_entries" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "l1_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "context" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "suggestion" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new', "personal_item_ids" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recordings" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_ref" TEXT NULL, "attempt_id" TEXT NULL, "audio_path" TEXT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL, "asr" TEXT NULL, "annotation" TEXT NULL, "metrics" TEXT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NULL, "is_assessment" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_assessment" IN (0, 1)), "assessment_id" TEXT NULL, "keep" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("keep" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assessments" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "results" TEXT NOT NULL, "level_estimates" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "writings" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "drafts" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "feedback" TEXT NULL, "final_text" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ended_at" TEXT NULL, "planned" TEXT NULL, "done" TEXT NULL, "active_ms" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "strand_ms" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "media_logs" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "subtitles" TEXT NULL, "with_partner" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("with_partner" IN (0, 1)), "day" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "subtitle_imports" ("updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "coverage" REAL NULL, "unknown" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'imported', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_reports" ("server_seq" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "pending_push" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pending_push" IN (0, 1)), "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_ref" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "context" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_state" ("profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_server_seq" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("profile_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "profile_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "platform" TEXT NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NULL, "last_sync_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_packs" ("pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "l2" TEXT NOT NULL, "l1" TEXT NULL, "version" REAL NOT NULL, "manifest" TEXT NOT NULL, "checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "imported_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("pack_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_items" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "text_l2" TEXT NULL, "lemmas" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "targets" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "grammar" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "rank" INTEGER NULL, "deprecated" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deprecated" IN (0, 1)), "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_links" ("from_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("from_key", "to_key", "type"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_forms" ("form" TEXT NOT NULL, "lemma" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("form", "lemma"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_texts" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "lemmas" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_tasks" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "content_pair_entries" ("kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL, "pack_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "data" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("kind", "key"));
CREATE INDEX cards_profile_due ON cards (profile_id, due)
CREATE INDEX attempts_card ON attempts (card_id)
CREATE INDEX attempts_profile_time ON attempts (profile_id, created_at_client)
CREATE INDEX gap_entries_profile_status ON gap_entries (profile_id, status)
